Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Jonathan Mid-Century Modern Mirror Wood Frame, 52", Walnut
Colors: Walnut
Materials: walnut
This mirror mounts onto the classic mid-century modern Henley Dresser - and will have you reveling in retro style as you get dressed each morning. 52"W x 1.63"D x 40"H Beveled mirror glass Easy assembly in 15 minutes; just bolt to dresser Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
